ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Broadcast Meteorology Introduction to the fundamentals of preparing and presenting radio and television weather broadcasts. Emphasis is placed on the gathering of meteorological information, preparing weather forecasts for broadcast, using professional weather graphics software, and developing presentation skills. Special topics include science/environmental reporting and severe weather coverage. Meets with ATMS 491-P This section open only to juniors and seniors in Broadcast journalism until November 11.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Journalism or Broadcast Journalism major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
